overview: Out of financial need, 25-year-old Ayla, a highly gifted astrophysics student and devout Muslim, takes up poker. Fascinated by the game and influenced by former pro Vincent, she risks everything.
title: High Stakes

overview: The arrival of Suzane Von Richthofen shakes Tremembé's order, sparking a power struggle with Elize Matsunaga. Jatobá seeks protection, while Nardoni, the Cravinhos brothers, Roger A. and others face internal clashes and defy the system.
title: Tremembé

overview: Zara McDermott travels to Thailand to discover an exotic paradise with two conflicting sides. Beyond the golden beaches and bustling cities lie wild parties, drugs and cheap sex.
title: Thailand: The Dark Side of Paradise

overview: In this original series, Goodwin doesn't simply revisit the past—she transports viewers into the very heart of America's most consequential presidential decisions. Command Decisions: Presidents on the Brink dramatizes the moment when leadership is tested and the course of history hangs in the balance. Each 8 to 10-minute episode immerses viewers alongside a U.S. president grappling with uncertainty, moral dilemmas, and the crushing weight of national responsibility. "These are not just stories from our past—they are timeless studies in courage, character, and conviction," said Goodwin. "By understanding how past presidents made decisions under extreme pressure, we gain insight into the qualities that define effective leadership—empathy, humility, teamwork, and perseverance. History reminds us that leadership is about growing through adversity, making tough choices, and learning from mistakes." From the Oval Office to the battlefield, the series explores how qualities like judgment, resilience, and emotional intelligence shaped the trajectory of a nation. It's not just about what happened—it's about the human capacity to think clearly and act boldly when the stakes are highest.
title: Command Decisions: Presidents on the Brink

overview: The story of Donald Trump's second term in office, told as you've never seen it before, using news footage cut as a real-life drama
title: The Donald Trump Show

overview: The main character of the series, psychologist Polina Mikhailova, at first glance seems like an ordinary specialist who can read people and notice details. But Polina has a unique gift: by touching an object or a person, she can see their past. Hiding her abilities from others, Polina gets a job in the police to find her missing sister, and begins working in tandem with Captain Igor Vetrov. Igor is a professional to the core, an analyst and a skeptic who does not believe in any miracles or supernatural phenomena. However, as the investigation progresses, he is forced to admit: he cannot do without Polina's gift, and she herself is not only an unusual person, but also a valuable partner.
title: Менталистка

overview: Subtle family sitcom following Cathy as she moves on from the death of her husband. Starting with the funeral in January and ending on New Year's Eve, the story unfolds through the events of a year.
title: Mum

overview: A young man's single TikTok post unexpectedly launches him to social media stardom, creating a devoted following that tests the limits between online celebrity and real-world relationships.
title: Thirst Trap: The Fame. The Fantasy. The Fallout.

overview: In their new series, Building Baeumler, Bryan and Sarah Baeumler take viewers inside their high-stakes world of buying and building. We follow the power couple as they take on a hotel renovation in the Florida Keys, invest in an ambitious expansion of their Bahamas resort, and tackle a personal renovation back home in Canada – all while juggling their family commitments. Bryan and Sarah are pulling back the curtain to share it all; from every setback to every celebration. This is building like only the Baeumlers can do!
title: Building Baeumler

overview: At Easton Prep, newcomer Teagan trades her oars for a cox seat on the boys-only rowing team — but can she earn their trust and lead them to victory?
title: Crew Girl

overview: Comedians ad-lib their way through irresistibly bawdy scenarios in this series produced by variety show veteran Nobuyuki Sakuma ("Last One Standing").
title: Kiss or Die

overview: Two representatives of an extraterrestrial civilization have been sent to our planet to find the missing son of the Emperor and help him complete a secret mission. The aliens mimic humans and pose as an ordinary couple, Anton and Marina. In order not to attract too much attention, they try to do all the same things as others: go to work, communicate with friends and colleagues, engage in everyday life. At first, the aliens have a very difficult time. However, they gradually get used to it, and Anton sees more and more advantages in earthly life and does not want to return to his native planet.
title: Планетяне

overview: Spin-off series of the classic quiz. Four contestants answer two minutes on a sporting specialist subject and two minutes on sporting general knowledge.
title: Sport Mastermind

overview: Victoria comes to the throne at a time of great economic turbulence and resurgent republicanism – and died 64 years later the head of the largest empire the world had ever seen, having revitalised the throne's public image and become ‘grandmother of Europe'. The first series of Victoria, will tell the story of the first years of the reign, beginning with the moment of the Queen's accession in 1837, following her first faltering steps from capricious, hormonal teenager with a weak grasp on her duties and responsibilities to her marriage to Albert. The show is a saga of interlocking circles – the circuits of power in Buckingham Palace and Westminster, the intermarrying royal houses of Europe and the scandals of the below-stairs palace staff. At the centre stands the new Queen – a spirited, passionate woman who must, somehow, become an enduring icon of stability and strength.
title: Victoria

overview: In misty Dalat, young artist Việt arrives at a small homestay to heal from heartbreak, only to meet Dũng, its quiet yet warmhearted owner. Through shared meals, fleeting glances, and gentle moments, their bond deepens amidst lingering sorrows, family burdens, and unspoken pasts. Around them, other tender connections bloom, all under the watchful care of Grandma Thái, who believes in love in every form. In a city where time moves slowly, love, too, finds its way — fragile, tested, but unforgettable.
title: Chờ Ngày Nắng Lên
Wo Zai Kong Jian Liu Fang Zhi De Dai Quan Jia Jue Qi

overview: The pilot dies in the air, and a corrupt official who has never flown an airplane takes his place at the helm! Soon, real chaos begins on board: bees, former accomplices, flight attendants with actors who were taught to fly only in the movies — complete absurdity!
title: Рейс 314

overview: Set in Republican-era Yuncheng, the story follows two sisters of vastly different backgrounds, Song Jiayu and Huo Ran, who are forced into a family conspiracy and struggle to survive in its treacherous whirlpool. From rivals to allies, they join hands—using business strategy to outwit powerful forces and Jianghu tactics to strike back step by step. In the end, they not only expose their father's true face but also reclaim the ancestral property left by their mother, transforming the oppressive Huo residence into a school and hospital dedicated to helping women. Through the power of women, they tear through the darkness and rewrite their destinies in the dawn of a new era.
title: Be Her Resilience

overview: When the body of a cartel member is found on US soil, Sonya Cross from El Paso PD and her Mexican counterpart, Marco Ruiz must work together to solve the case. A present-day crime thriller exploring the tensions on the US-Mexico border. When an American judge known for her anti-immigration views is found dead on the bridge connecting El Paso and Juarez, Sonya Cross from El Paso PD must work with her Mexican counterpart from Chihuahua State Police, Marco Ruiz, to catch a serial killer operating on both sides of the border. Marco understands the slippery politics of Mexican law enforcement, and while his police force slowly succumbs to the pressures and demands of the cartel, he's one of the last good men in the department. He's charming but will do whatever it takes to get what he needs -- which doesn't sit well with Sonya, who has Asperger's and strictly follows rules and protocol. The case quickly pulls them into a string of murders on the border, a scene already consumed by illegal immigration, drug trafficking, violence, and prostitution.
title: The Bridge

overview: Battlestar Galactica: Blood & Chrome (a prequel to the critically acclaimed hit series, Battlestar Galactica) takes place in the midst of the First Cylon war. As the battle between humans and their creation, the sentient robotic Cylons, rages across the 12 colonial worlds, a young, talented fighter pilot, William Adama, finds himself assigned to one of the most powerful battlestars in the Colonial fleet: the Galactica. Full of ambition and in pursuit of the intense action that the Cylon war promises, Adama quickly finds himself at odds with his co-pilot, the battle-weary officer Coker. With only 47 days left in his tour of duty, Coker desires an end to battle just as much as Adama craves the start of it. Though they clash at first, the two men forge an unlikely bond when a routine escort mission with an enigmatic passenger turns dangerous and becomes a pivotal one for the desperate fleet.
title: Battlestar Galactica: Blood & Chrome

overview: A comedy set in the fictitious, contemporary court of Henry IX, King of the United Kingdom.
title: Henry IX

overview: David Rubenstein learns key investment strategies and tactics from a high-profile roster of professional investing luminaries.
title: Bloomberg Wealth with David Rubenstein

overview: Guts & Glory flips the script on the traditional competition show - thrusting players into an immersive horror experience full of unexpected challenges. The new series blends the intensity of a horror film with the pressure of a survival game where contestants are confronted with their fears in various scenarios.
title: Guts & Glory

overview: Gabby Logan hosts High Tackle, a Six Nations comedy quiz with Eddie Butler captaining a team of Welsh celebrities as they tackle their counterparts from the other nations.
title: High Tackle

overview: Anastasia, a psychologist, and Viktor, the head of the cosmodrome, are conducting an experiment: will the team be able to cope with a two-year flight to Mars? Experienced cosmonaut Kovalev, his ex-wife and physician Natalia, biologist Oksana, flight engineer Platon and Chinese cosmonaut Wei do not even realize that they will spend two years not in space, but in the pavilion. Everything goes according to plan, until Mitrich accidentally turns up at the cosmodrome...
title: Митрич

overview: Inside Melbourne Airport takes viewers behind the scenes of Australia's busiest 24-hour airport. With over 35 million passengers moving through its terminals each year, the team work around the clock to manage complex challenges – from flight delays, tight turnarounds, runway maintenance, baggage mishaps and flight emergencies. It's up to the dedicated team to make split-second decisions that keep the airport running safely and smoothly and on time.
title: Inside Melbourne Airport

overview: Gyles Brandreth presents the quiz without questions. Contestants have their breadth of knowledge tested to the limit as they battle it out to impress the show's experts.
title: Knowitalls

overview: Matt Edmondson presents a game show using games based on psychological research. The show tests the teams' creativity, emotional intelligence, physical dexterity and practical skills.
title: Clever v Stupid

overview: Leanne and Rhona are two ordinary flatmates whose lives are thrown into disarray after witnessing a gangland shooting.
title: Witless

overview: This series reveals the extraordinary secrets of Europe's engineering wonders. Filmed across six great nations, it will explore record-breaking construction projects, innovative machines and vehicles, and ingenious design. It will also reveal the hidden engineering that drives Europe's most iconic landmarks and the people who keep them working today.
title: Engineering Europe

overview: Award-winning investigations - revealing secrets, rooting out injustice, and exposing crime, corruption, and abuse. The biggest stories from BBC correspondents all over the world.
title: Global Eye

overview: Chris Corcoran chairs a comedy quiz about Wales and Welsh life. Showing as part of the BBC Wales Real Valleys season.
title: Whose Coat is That Jacket?

overview: A festive quiz with a strong Welsh connection. Chris Corcoran is in the chair alongside team captains comedian Elis James and chair of Radio 4's The News Quiz, Miles Jupp.
title: The Really Welsh Quiz

overview: Jonathan Davies presents a rugby quiz in which teams of celebrities and players take on supporters from the Welsh rugby regions.
title: Jonathan's Six Nations Quiz

overview: Graham Norton and guests look back at the year.
title: The Big Finish

overview: Sitcom about the lives and loves of six twenty-to-thirty-something adults living together as Property Guardians in a disused hospital.
title: Crashing

overview: When love, jealousy and hate form a gruesome cocktail, things go wrong... Reconstructions of murder cases in the relationship sphere.
title: Moordzaken Liefde Is Geen Alibi

overview: Traveling through different countries, Pedro Elias and Robin Pront train for one year for a real cage fight. Along the way, they discover the origin and values of various fighting disciplines.
title: Kooiboys

overview: After the birth of his son, Tonnano wants to leave his criminal past behind and build an honest life in the Achterhoek region, where his girlfriend Amani and her family live. His arrival causes unrest among the notorious Eysinck drug family. Amani's uncle turns out to owe debts to this family, and Tonnano is drawn back into the underworld.
title: Tonnano

overview: Into The Void explores the epic struggles and the cultural impacts made by heavy metal's most compelling artists. Their intensely personal stories about finding success offer a unique combination of volume and distortion through tales of murder, addiction, rebellion, and redemption.
title: Into The Void: Life, Death & Heavy Metal

overview: The pressure of Silicon Valley turns dreamers dark, as Lt. Sandra Brown uncovers murdered tech tycoons and millionaire killers.
title: The Tech Bro Murders

overview: One of the engines of the plane flying from Delhi to San Francisco failed, and the airliner had to make an emergency landing at Magadan airport. Now passengers and crew members are forced to spend an indefinite amount of time in the harsh northern capital of Kolyma. Sending foreigners to their homeland is an almost impossible task. It is impossible to send another plane for the guests because of the destroyed runway during the emergency landing. The only salvation is the locals, who cordially help foreigners in trouble and accommodate guests at the nearest school. It is here that the difficult everyday life of American business class passengers, colorful Indians and a young Indian IT specialist Vasant will take place.
title: Намасте, Магадан!

overview: Elena is the director of the most prestigious gymnasium in the city. In her youth, she experienced betrayal by her beloved man and best friend, lost her child and gave up on her personal life, preferring to build a career. One day, a former friend approaches her with a request to arrange for her daughter Olya. Lena barely recognizes her - her husband died, the rest of the money is spent on fighting a serious illness. Lena succumbs to temptation and agrees to arrange for the girl to go to the gymnasium for a large bribe - this is retribution for Sonya's betrayal. A friend sells an old family ring and gives Lena a bribe. From this moment on, events begin to develop completely unpredictably, dramatically and unexpectedly, involving more and more new people. Elena will have to correct her own mistakes, learn to forgive, trust people and find her love.
title: Взятка

overview: Michael Palin's latest epic journey is to often troubled but little explored Venezuela, a huge and once oil rich country that has been called the most dangerous in South America; under authoritarian rule, financially in meltdown and facing massive social challenges from this economic collapse. But it is also one of the most beautiful places in the world where visitors are few and awe-inspiring regions remain unexplored. When Michael arrives, Venezuela is still reeling from the controversial re-election of Nicolás Maduro as President, a man whose style is often more showbiz or self-styled superhero than presidential. Economic turmoil has led eight million people to flee the country in the last ten years. But Venezuela also has the longest Caribbean coast, the world's tallest waterfall and the Andes mountains; it should be on every traveller's wish list. From Caracas to the Amazon rainforest and the Caribbean Sea, Michael embarks on a thrilling, if sometimes risky, adventure into a dystopian Paradise.
title: Michael Palin in Venezuela

overview: Olivia, Marta, and Carlota are three friends leading normal lives, until a moment of panic changes everything: an unexpected confrontation with Olivia's ex-boyfriend, Jaime, ends tragically when he accidentally dies. Consumed by the fear of losing their freedom during the best years of their lives, the three make a radical decision: to hide the body and conceal what happened that night. What begins as an act of desperation quickly devolves into an uncontrollable spiral of lies, improvised crimes, and growing paranoia. Between loose ends, unexpected mistakes, and the constant threat of discovery, they plunge into a series of crimes that become increasingly difficult to justify.
title: Situações Delicadas

overview: The project "Motive of Crime" is a story of crimes committed on the basis of jealousy, revenge or unrequited love. The participants of the events are not superheroes, but ordinary people, like you and me, and because of this, the events that unfold in each episode of the series become especially interesting and close, touching to the quick. Alexander Polovtsev, an experienced TV detective, tells the viewer about "Motive of Crime". He confidently leads the viewer through the twists and turns of a complex plot, reporting more and more new details, until he finally finds out the main thing - who the killer is and what the motive for the crime was.
title: Мотив преступления

overview: To mark the 200th anniversary of the birth of rail, Britain's Railway Empire in Colour reveals the extraordinary story of how Britain gave railways to the world – from the first tentative experiments with steam power, through the boom years at home, to the exporting of this new technology to every corner of the globe. Using leading experts and enthusiasts, including TikTok trainspotter Francis Bourgeois, plus extensive newly colourised archive, the truly revolutionary invention and impact of the locomotive is explored.
title: Britain's Railway Empire in Colour

overview: September 2025 marks 200 years since the first steam-hauled passenger train ran on a public railway, from Stockton to Darlington, in 1825. To celebrate this incredible anniversary, Michael Portillo is set to take audiences on a journey through time with: 200 Years of The Railways. The series will see Michael Portillo travel by train to the Northeast and Northwest of England and investigate what the railways have done for us over the past 200 years and explore what the railways' role could be in the future.
title: Michael Portillo's 200 Years of the Railways

overview: The investigations of Police Chief Fred Caïn, a cop in a wheelchair with a strong character and a scathing humour. He also doesn't hesitate to take advantage of his disability in order to bypass the law and common decency...
title: Cain

overview: A young girl's life is turned upside down when her kidney is stolen during a violent kidnapping, orchestrated by her rich biological father who needs a donor.
title: Alaca

overview: After 6 years of finding her feet on the farm Nadia Lim is diving back into her kitchen to create a mouth-watering collection of exciting new dishes inspired by food sourced from Royalburn Station and all over the deep south.
title: Nadia's Farm Kitchen

overview: Clive Anderson hosts a brain training quiz show in which contestants battle to prove themselves in a sequence of brain games which test their memory, language, visual, numerical and spacial skills.
title: Brainbox Challenge

overview: Two teams featuring some of the brightest brains in Britain go head-to-head in a game of nerve, strategy and skill.
title: Battle of the Brains

overview: Unique technological landmarks in individual regions of the Czech Republic. What traces have they left in the landscape?
title: Technické památky českých zemí

overview: Crisis at the Castle is a series about aristocratic families trying to save their homes.
title: Crisis at the Castle

overview: Azra's story begins like a fairytale, but her life quickly turns into a nightmare. As the daughter-in-law of the Karaaslan family, she lives a seemingly perfect life, but behind this splendor lurks dark secrets. Forced to pay a heavy price while trying to escape with her daughter, Azra finds only one way to reunite with her: to change her face and return to that house as someone else. On this journey, she meets the successful plastic surgeon Barış Saygıner, and on the operating table, he rewrites not only her face but also her destiny. However, the shadows of the past and an impossible love will be Azra's greatest test.
title: Aynadaki Yabancı

overview: The stories behind the Welsh music legends who sold a million records.
title: They Sold a Million

overview: The Voice Kids is a Belgian music talent show for aspiring singers aged 8 to 14, based on the concept of the show The Voice van Vlaanderen. The first broadcast took place on 5 September 2014 on VTM. The first season was won by Mentissa Aziza, the second by Jens Dolleslagers, the third by Katarina Pohlodkova, and the fourth by Jade De Rijcke. A fifth season is expected to premiere in late 2020 after a one-year break.
title: The Voice Kids

overview: The delicate balance between love and power are shaken up when a self-made businessman and a rival yacht designer are swept up in a captivating romance.
title: Enfes Bir Akşam

overview: When Roland's wife Emma leaves him with their teenage daughter Mia who barely notices him and Beattie, the dog he never wanted in the first place, he's determined to cope brilliantly. But when Beattie disappears and turns up at the local dog park, Roland meets the unbearably optimistic Samantha and her mismatched, life-loving group of dog-parkers. As Roland begrudgingly keeps returning to the park, he comes to realise he might actually need a community to belong to.
title: Dog Park

overview: Poignant documentaries following two survivors of the 1998 Omagh bombing, narrated by Liam Neeson.
title: Omagh - The Legacy

overview: Get ready for some thrills and chills with Channel Zero, a horror anthology series. Each six hour installment draws inspiration from a different "creepypasta" (user-generated horror stories published online).
title: Channel Zero

overview: In 1711, the Ottoman Empire defeated the Russian Empire and entered a period of stagnation. The story begins with Patrona Halil's brother hanging with the order of the sultan. The Ottomans got away from the war and organized more fun in the tulips gardens. The opponents of the Janissaries and some anti-Sultan gangs trying to organize can not dare a rebel.
title: Osmanlida Derin Devlet

overview: Hosted by retired Air Force combat photographer Stacy Pearsall, the acclaimed PBS series After Action offers a powerful, inside look at what life is like before, during and after action through candid conversations with veterans from around the country. By sharing her own struggles with reintegrating into civilian life, Pearsall encourages fellow veterans to delve deeper into their personal stories, fostering a greater understanding and appreciation for those who have served. The series seeks to demystify the military experience, spark dialogue among family members and preserve military stories, many of which remain untold.
title: After Action

overview: Set in south county Dublin, Grown Ups follows the chaotic lives of the Casey clan, a noisy, tight-knit Irish family, who are bound together by a tangled web of loyalty, resentment, money, memory, and love. When the rock of the family, the "good son," dies unexpectedly, it sets off a seismic emotional reckoning. Over the course of the next year, the Caseys will fall in and out of love, confront old wounds and make some new ones. They'll be forced to face not only their grief, but the exhausting, relentless, and often ridiculous struggle of being an adult. Despite their age and responsibilities, the Caseys are far from grown up.
title: Grown Ups

overview: The Detection Club, set in 1930s London, the golden age of detective fiction, sees the mysterious society of the three most famous crime writers of our time Agatha Christie, Dorothy L. Sayers and G.K. Chesterton, join forces to solve real-life murders. Honing their craft within the hallowed walls of a secret London location, the three writers come together after receiving an invitation that leads them to their first real murder case. The series follows the trio as they work together to crack cases, all to the despair of D.I. Greenway a young, rookie, real-life detective.
title: The Detection Club

overview: The Hairdresser Mysteries is a nostalgic nod to the 70s which sees a high-end hairdresser, Lily Petal, opt out of the competitive city scene to buy a small village hairdressers at the top of a cobbled street. Everyone tells their hairdresser everything and soon she is at the hub of her new village's secrets and revelations, and with her own brand of uncannily highly developed, hairdressing intuitive empathy and understanding, solves the village mysteries.
title: The Hairdresser Mysteries

overview: Bromance is an American reality television series that originally aired on MTV from December 29, 2008 until February 2, 2009. It was developed as a spin-off of 'The Hills' and aired one six-episode season. The series focused on Brody Jenner, who appeared in its predecessor, and enlisted nine men to compete for the opportunity to win a close male friendship ("bromance") with him. On February 2, 2009, it was revealed on air that Jenner had chosen Luke Verge as his new best friend. Along with Jenner's friendship and a spot in his entourage, Verge won a one year, rent-free stay in a fully furnished penthouse in downtown Los Angeles and a new Scion.
title: Bromance

overview: In this intense documentary series, renowned Dr Nandipha Magudumana is entangled in Thabo Bester's prison break — but is she an accomplice or a victim?
title: Beauty and the Bester
80 Jie Mei De Jiao Huan Ren Sheng

overview: In the 12-episode series, vintage design expert Lara Spencer presents two designer duos with identical rooms. With limited time and budget, teams must treasure hunt for vintage and thrift store finds to design their way to beautiful, layered, finished rooms. It's style and sustainability in a race against the clock.
title: That Thrifting Show With Lara Spencer

overview: Chen Gongxi, the unassuming owner of a teahouse in Beimen Alley, is actually a hidden Mahjong master. When a corporate rivalry intensifies, three women seek him out, urging him to return to the scene. To protect the vibrant life of the old street, he joins forces with his confidante to battle the schemes of a business tycoon. Amidst the deceptive Mahjong games, the young prodigy repeatedly turns the tide, saving the community from crisis. Just as he is about to win the beauty's heart, a long-buried truth about his past unexpectedly emerges...
title: Money Money Come

overview: El Dentista follows Nolasco Black, a forensic dentist investigating the brutal murder of a prostitute. As he digs deeper into the case, he relives a personal tragedy and uncovers evidence that Jack the Ripper has arrived in America. With the support of the secret society Flammarion and Sofía, a brilliant chemist who becomes both his ally and love interest, Nolasco embarks on a dangerous hunt to stop the killer before more victims fall.
title: El Dentista

overview: Featuring conversations with newsmakers across the political landscape, Saturday in America with Kayleigh McEnany will provide a comprehensive look at the headlines dominating the news cycle.
title: Saturday in America
